providers.name: Google Play (GMS)
providers.desc: For devices with Google Play services. Uses Google Maps and Google location services.

providers.name: Huawei AppGallery (HMS)
providers.desc: For Huawei devices without Google Play services. Uses Huawei Map Kit, Location Kit and ML Kit (document scanning) instead.

variants.name: SDK without tracking
variants.desc: Only the Almatar SDK. No analytics, attribution, engagement or session-replay tools are included, and the SDK's analytics calls do nothing.

variants.name: SDK with tracking tools
variants.desc: The Almatar SDK plus the optional com.almatar:analytics-tracking add-on. Tracking runs only inside the Almatar flows (hotel, flight and bookings screens). The add-on registers itself at app startup, so no code changes are needed.

flows.name: B2C
flows.desc: Consumer integration. Initialize with enableB2bSDK = false and launch any of the hotel / flight / bookings flows directly.
flows.init:
AlmatarAppInitializer.init(
    application = this,
    baseUrl = "<your base url>",
    almatarEnvironment = AlmatarEnvironment.Production,
    supportNumber = "<support number>",
    almatarUiConfig = AlmatarUiConfig(),
    enableB2bSDK = false,
)

flows.name: B2B
flows.desc: Corporate (e.g. Aamal) integration. Initialize with enableB2bSDK = true and a brandName. Same launch flows as B2C, with the corporate section enabled on payment.
flows.init:
AlmatarAppInitializer.init(
    application = this,
    baseUrl = "<your base url>",
    almatarEnvironment = AlmatarEnvironment.Production,
    supportNumber = "<support number>",
    almatarUiConfig = AlmatarUiConfig(),
    enableB2bSDK = true,
    brandName = "<your brand>",
)

flows.name: B2B with SSO
flows.desc: Corporate SSO integration. Initialize in B2B mode, then hand the SDK a short-lived SSO token via launchB2BSsoBookings. Only the SSO bookings entry point is valid in this flow.

versions.notes: First tracking-free release: the tracking tools moved out of core-gms into the optional com.almatar:analytics-tracking add-on. Pin this exact version. Gradle ranks 1.0.0-alpha01 below 1.0.5, so a version range or 'latest' resolves to 1.0.5, which still bundles the tracking tools.

permissions.name: com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES
permissions.from: Fingerprint Pro, used by Checkout.com fraud checks

tools.name: UXCam
tools.purpose: Session replay and heatmaps; passenger and payment fields are masked

tools.name: Firebase Messaging
tools.purpose: Push notifications for the engagement tools

added.name: AlmatarAppInitializer.init
added.signature:
fun init(
    application: Application,
    baseUrl: String,
    almatarEnvironment: AlmatarEnvironment,
    supportNumber: String,
    almatarUiConfig: AlmatarUiConfig = AlmatarUiConfig(),
    supportedCountry: SupportedCountry = SupportedCountry.ALL,
    enableSDK: Boolean = true,
    enableB2bSDK: Boolean = false,
    brandName: String? = null,
)
added.desc: Bootstraps the SDK (API/console URLs, environment, support number, UI config). Set enableB2bSDK = true and a brandName for B2B / SSO.
